description: Selected FINAL RPC proof fields. Transaction signatures, verdict signatures and outcome Merkle proofs are omitted. The raw public signatures remain in the immutable RPC captures outside the repository. FunctionCall args are decoded as args_json. The raw DeployContract code field is preserved; it decodes to the 32-byte SHA-256 of res/gate.wasm, not the full wasm payload. Immutable full RPC captures remain in the operator handoff.
